slides.title: Prompting: Talking to AI
content: AI models are like smart interns. They need clear instructions.
Prompting is the art of giving these instructions to get high-quality results.
narration: Imagine you have a very smart intern.
This intern can do amazing things but needs very specific instructions.
Prompting is exactly that.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration of a person talking to a friendly robot or AI assistant, showing clear and effective communication.

slides.title: The 3 C's of a Good Prompt: Clarity
content: Be specific in your request. Avoid vague language.
Weak Prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post about the top three benefits of owning an electric car for someone in a city.'
narration: A good prompt has three main parts, which we call the 3 C's.
First is Clarity. Be specific.
The AI does not know what you are thinking.
For example, instead of 'Write about electric cars', try:
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass highlighting the word 'Clarity', with a clear, specific example prompt contrasted with a vague one.

slides.title: The 3 C's: Context and Constraints
content: Context: Tell AI why and for whom.
Example: '...for a lifestyle blog on sustainable living.'
Constraints: Set rules for length, format, tone.
Example: '...under 400 words, friendly tone, end with a question.'
narration: Next, we have Context.
This tells the AI the background for your request.
For our example, add 'for a sustainable living blog'.
The third C is Constraints.
These set rules for the output.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration showing a puzzle piece connecting for context, and a ruler or boundary symbol for constraints.

slides.title: Advanced Prompting: Persona & Structure
content: Persona: Tell AI 'who to be'.
Example: 'Act as a fitness coach...'
Output Structure: Specify desired format.
Example: '...present it in a table format...'
narration: You can also use advanced techniques.
One powerful trick is 'Persona'.
Tell the AI who to act as.
For instance, say 'Act as an expert travel agent'.
You can also guide the output structure.
slides.image_prompt: Two distinct icons: a mask representing persona and a structured grid representing output format.

slides.title: Iterative Prompting: It's a Conversation
content: Refine your prompts based on AI's output.
Treat it like a chat.
You: 'Write a slogan.'
AI: 'Brewing happiness...'
You: 'Make it shorter.'
AI: 'Urban Brews...'
narration: Remember, your first prompt is rarely your last.
Treat prompting like a conversation.
If the AI's answer is not perfect, ask it to refine.
For example, if it gives a slogan, you can ask,
'Can you make it shorter and more modern?'
slides.image_prompt: Speech bubbles showing a back-and-forth conversation between a person icon and an AI icon, indicating refinement.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Open an AI chatbot.
Ask it: 'Act as a chef. Give three healthy breakfast ideas for busy office workers. Present the output as a numbered list with ingredients and quick steps.'
narration: Now, for your assignment.
Open an AI chatbot like ChatGPT or Gemini.
Your task is to apply what you learned.
